meta.title: Warren Buffett's Famous Company Began As A Bad Investment
meta.hook: Berkshire Hathaway started as a dying textile mill Warren Buffett later called a mistake.
meta.description: Berkshire Hathaway was formed from New England textile businesses and came under Warren Buffett's control in 1965. The textile operation consumed capital in a declining industry, so Buffett redirected cash into insurance and other businesses while retaining the Berkshire name.

scenes.narration: Berkshire Hathaway started as a dying textile mill, an investment Warren Buffett later described as a major mistake.

visual.visual_intent: Dusty textile machinery turning inside an old mill
visual.decision_reason: Berkshire shareholder letters call the original textile operation beleaguered and a mistake

scenes.narration: The name came from New England textile businesses that merged in nineteen fifty-five, long before today's conglomerate existed.

visual.visual_intent: An archival-looking brick mill beside a river

scenes.narration: Buffett's partnership acquired control in early nineteen sixty-five, when the operation needed nearly all of Berkshire's capital.

visual.visual_intent: A vintage stock certificate and dated control documents
visual.decision_reason: Berkshire 2019 letter confirms control in early 1965 and capital intensity

scenes.narration: Textiles faced relentless competition and demanded more investment without producing attractive returns. The economic engine was failing.

visual.decision_reason: Buffett letters repeatedly explain the textile business's poor economics

scenes.narration: Buffett gradually redirected capital into insurance and other businesses, where cash could be reinvested more productively.

visual.visual_intent: Capital arrows moving from factory to insurance building
visual.decision_reason: Berkshire letters document the shift toward better businesses including insurance

scenes.narration: The textile mills eventually disappeared, but their name survived on one of the world's best-known holding companies.

visual.visual_intent: A restrained corporate office exterior after the mill fades
visual.decision_reason: Closing contrast based on the documented corporate transformation
